question: The Padma Bhushan award in the field of sports was bestowed on ________ for the year 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devendra Jhajharia **is an Indian Paralympic javelin thrower competing in** F46 events.** He made history as the first Indian Paralympian to win two gold medals at the Paralympics.
 
• His first gold came at the 2004 Summer Paralympics in Athens, making him the second gold medalist for India at the Paralympics.
 
• In the **2016 Summer Paralympics in Rio de Janeiro,** he secured his second gold medal in the same event, surpassing his previous record.</li&
